login.locked: Too many wrong passwords. Try again in a few minutes.
banner.welcomeApp: Welcome to Clearr. Start by connecting Jellyfin (and Sonarr/Radarr) in Settings.
banner.welcomePlugin: Welcome to Clearr. Start by connecting Sonarr and/or Radarr in Settings.
modeOption.DryRun: Dry run – log what would be removed
modeNote.delete: "{deleteNow}" removes files right after you confirm the list.
modeNote.safe: Nothing can be removed in this mode. "{preview}" shows what would go. Use {keep} to protect something.
library.noSonarr: Sonarr isn't connected, so no show can be removed yet.
library.noRadarr: Radarr isn't connected, so no movie can be removed yet.
library.summaryShows: {count} shows · tracking {users} · {shows} whole shows and {seasons} seasons ready to clear
pill.viaJellyfinTitle: Not managed by {arr}; would be removed through Jellyfin
keep.external: Kept by a {by}; remove it there
result.nothing: Nothing is ready to clear right now.
confirm.title: PERMANENTLY remove {count} item(s), {size}?
logs.hint: Newest first. Turn on Debug logging in Settings to see every decision; attach the files when reporting a problem.
settings.arrHint: Sonarr and Radarr delete the files, and Clearr unmonitors what's removed so it isn't downloaded again. Shows stay monitored, so new seasons still arrive.
settings.allowDirectDelete: Also remove items Sonarr/Radarr don't manage, through Jellyfin
settings.allowDirectDeleteHint: Off by default. When on, finished shows and movies that Sonarr/Radarr don't know about are deleted from disk by Jellyfin itself. They are not unmonitored anywhere, so if another tool manages them they may come back.
settings.modesHint: Shows and movies each have their own mode and daily run. A mode applies to its daily run and to "Delete eligible now" on that page. Nothing is ever removed unless it's Delete.
settings.modesHintPlugin: Shows and movies each have their own mode. Their daily runs are Jellyfin scheduled tasks with their own schedules: Dashboard → Scheduled Tasks → Clearr. Nothing is ever removed unless the mode is Delete.
settings.timeZoneHint: Times are in the container's time zone (set TZ in Docker).
settings.requireEnded: Only remove whole shows that have Ended
settings.protectLatest: Never remove the newest season of a continuing show
settings.maxGbHint: 0 = no limit. Anything over the limit waits for the next run.
settings.grace: Grace period (days after the last viewer finished)
settings.refreshJellyfin: Refresh the Jellyfin library after a cleanup
settings.keepTagHint: Items with this tag in Jellyfin, Sonarr or Radarr are never removed. Keep buttons add it in Sonarr/Radarr too.
settings.inactiveDays: Flag a viewer after this many days without progress
settings.sampledMax: "Sampled" means watched at most this many episodes
settings.sampledHint: More than that is "Stalled". "Mid-episode" is added if they stopped partway through.
settings.abandonedBlock: Dropped-off viewers still hold back cleanup
settings.usersHint: Ticked users are ignored completely (for example a test or kids account).
settings.debugLoggingHint: Writes every decision to the log files (Logs page). Leave off unless you're tracking down a problem.
settings.passwordSet: A password is set. Enter a new one to change it.
settings.noPassword: No password is set. Clearr only answers devices on your local network until you set one.
https.hint: Not needed if a reverse proxy (like Nginx Proxy Manager) already handles HTTPS for Clearr. Plain HTTP always stays on port 8585.
https.portHint: Inside the container. Map it in Docker too, e.g. 8586:8586.
https.certificatePlaceholder: Leave empty for a self-signed certificate
https.certificateHint: A path inside the container: .pfx/.p12, or a PEM certificate such as /certs/fullchain.pem. Mount the folder read-only.
https.keyHint: For PEM certificates only. Not needed for .pfx.
https.passwordHint: Only for password-protected .pfx files or encrypted keys.
https.restartNeeded: HTTPS changes take effect after a restart.
https.didntComeBack: Clearr didn't come back. Is the container set to restart: unless-stopped?
reason.allDropped: Nobody has finished it (everyone who started dropped off)
reason.kept: Everyone finished, but it's marked keep
block.newestSeason: Newest season of a show that's still continuing
block.notInSonarr: Not in Sonarr — Clearr only removes shows Sonarr manages
block.notInRadarr: Not in Radarr — Clearr only removes movies Radarr manages
block.showStatusUnknown: Show status is unknown (not marked Ended)
block.seasonKept: A season is marked keep (other seasons can still be removed)
outcome.unseen: Sonarr has {files} files in season {season} but Jellyfin only lists {known} episodes; waiting for Jellyfin to catch up
outcome.limit: Per-run limit of {gb} GB reached; will be handled on a later run
outcome.stoppedShows: Stopped: the cleanup mode for shows was changed to {mode} during the run
outcome.stoppedMovies: Stopped: the cleanup mode for movies was changed to {mode} during the run
outcome.viaJellyfin: would be removed through Jellyfin (not managed by Sonarr/Radarr)
outcome.movieDeleted: unmonitored and file deleted in Radarr
outcome.showDeleted: {files} files deleted in Sonarr; existing seasons unmonitored, show still monitored for new seasons
outcome.seasonDeleted: {files} files deleted in Sonarr; season unmonitored
error.refusedShows: Nothing was deleted: the cleanup mode for shows is {mode}. Set it to Delete in Settings first.
error.refusedMovies: Nothing was deleted: the cleanup mode for movies is {mode}. Set it to Delete in Settings first.
error.refusedBoth: Nothing was deleted: the cleanup mode is {shows} for shows and {movies} for movies. Set one to Delete in Settings first.
notice.upgraded: Settings upgraded from format {from} to {to}; the old file is kept as {file}.
notice.broken: settings.json couldn't be read ({error}); it was moved to {file} and Clearr started with default settings (Dry run).
notice.newer: These settings were saved by a newer Clearr (format {version}); a copy is kept as {file}.
